example: The mother who bashed her child on the head with a club was criticized by the public.
example_zh: 那個用棍棒猛擊孩子頭部的媽媽遭受大眾的批評。
memory_hint: bash 表重擊、猛擊。

example: The opera star that is going to give a performance tonight is a fine bass.
example_zh: 今晚要表演的歌劇明星是優秀的男低音歌手。
memory_hint: bass 指低音或男低音歌手。

example: She left all her fortune to her bastard, which peeved her husband.
example_zh: 她把所有的財產都留給了私生子，這讓她丈夫很生氣。
memory_hint: bastard 為貶義詞，原義私生子。

example: With batch files, which are also called batch programs, one can simplify routine or repetitive tasks.
example_zh: 利用批次檔案，又稱批次處理程式，可以簡化例行或重複性的任務。
memory_hint: batch 指一批、一組。

example: A battalion is generally the smallest military unit which is capable of independent operations.
example_zh: 營通常是軍隊裡最小的組織單位，能夠獨立作戰。
memory_hint: battalion 指軍隊中的營級單位。

example: The police battered down the door but found that the criminal had already gone.
example_zh: 員警把門猛力打開，卻發現罪犯已經逃走了。
memory_hint: batter 表連續猛擊。

example: He is bearish about the stock market.
example_zh: 他看跌股市。
memory_hint: bearish 在金融語境常指看跌的。

example: The beaten army refused to surrender.
example_zh: 被打敗的軍隊拒絕投降。
chinese: 踏平的；挨打的；筋疲力盡的
memory_hint: beaten 可表示被擊敗的，也可指筋疲力盡的。

example: The garden looked very bedraggled after the storm.
example_zh: 院子在暴風雨過後看起來又濕又髒。
memory_hint: bedraggled 指又濕又髒、凌亂的。

example: The computers in this studio beep regularly.
example_zh: 這個工作室的電腦發出有規律的嗶嗶聲。
memory_hint: beep 表發出短促嗶聲。

example: Beet sells well this year.
example_zh: 甜菜在今年很好賣。
memory_hint: beet 指甜菜。

example: They put up the proposal on your behalf, but now you blame them.
example_zh: 他們代表你提出了這個建議，但是現在你責備他們。
memory_hint: on behalf of 表代表、為了…的利益。

example: Her happy manner belied her real feelings.
example_zh: 她那高興的樣子掩飾了她真實的感情。
memory_hint: belie 指使表面印象與真相不符。

example: Don't belittle yourself unduly.
example_zh: 你不要妄自菲薄。
memory_hint: belittle 表貶低、輕視。

example: He is bellicose in nature.
example_zh: 他的本性是好鬥的。
memory_hint: bellicose 指好戰、好鬥。

example: We showed high respect to those benefactors.
example_zh: 我們對那些捐助者表達了崇高的敬意。
memory_hint: benefactor 指施恩者、捐助者。

example: He is the beneficiary of your generosity.
example_zh: 他是你慷慨解囊的受益人。
memory_hint: beneficiary 指從某事獲益的人。

example: The school received a benevolent donation.
example_zh: 學校接受了一筆慈善捐款。
memory_hint: benevolent 指仁慈、慈善的。

example: Don't worry. Your mother's growth is benign.
example_zh: 不要擔心，你母親的腫瘤是良性的。
memory_hint: benign 可指仁慈的，也可指腫瘤良性的。

example: His collection of paintings was bequeathed to the National Gallery.
example_zh: 他所有的藏畫都遺贈給了國家美術館。
memory_hint: bequeath 指以遺囑留下財產。

example: Besieged with fears, she decided to have a long holiday in the countryside.
example_zh: 她因恐懼而煩擾，所以決定到鄉下度個長假。
memory_hint: besiege 可指軍事包圍，也可比喻困擾。

example: The trophy was bestowed upon the winner.
example_zh: 獎品頒給了優勝者。
memory_hint: bestow A upon B 表把 A 贈與 B。

example: This alcoholic beverage with a concentration of more than 40% ethanol is not suitable for teenagers.
example_zh: 這種酒精度超過40%的酒精飲料不適合青少年飲用。
memory_hint: beverage 指飲料。

example: Bewildered by their explanation, I decided to find out the truth for myself.
example_zh: 我被他們的解釋弄糊塗了，所以決定自己去探究事實真相。
memory_hint: bewilder 表使困惑、迷糊。

example: You should list your bibliographies at the end of your essay.
example_zh: 你應該把參考書目列在報告的最後。
memory_hint: bibliography 指參考書目。

example: We are willing to offer you an opportunity to develop bilateral trade.
example_zh: 我們願提供您一個發展雙邊貿易的機會。
memory_hint: bilateral 指雙邊的、兩方面的。

example: They signed an agreement which was binding on both parties.
example_zh: 他們簽訂了一份對雙方都有約束力的協議。
chinese: 捆綁的；黏合的；有約束力的
memory_hint: binding on 表對…具有約束力。

example: Most of the people watched the football game through their binoculars.
example_zh: 大部分的人用雙筒望遠鏡看足球比賽。
memory_hint: bin- 可聯想「二」，ocular 表「眼睛的」，合起來記雙筒望遠鏡。

example: This institution is open to any individual all over the world, with an interest in biochemistry.
example_zh: 該機構向全世界任何對生物化學有興趣的人開放。
memory_hint: bio- 表生命、生物，chemistry 表化學。

example: The birdie is building a nest of straw and twigs.
example_zh: 這隻小鳥正在用稻草和小樹枝築巢。
memory_hint: bird 加表示小的字尾 -ie，可記為小鳥。

example: The mother was deeply concerned with her son's bizarre behavior and decided to have a talk with him.
example_zh: 母親很關心兒子古怪的行為，決定和他談一談。
memory_hint: bizarre 表古怪、異常。

example: He was blackmailed out of the company's secrets.
example_zh: 他被勒索而交出了公司的祕密。
memory_hint: black + mail，可記為「黑色的信件」般的勒索。

example: The old man suffered from inflammation of the bladder.
example_zh: 這個老人患有膀胱炎。
memory_hint: bladder 可聯想 ladder；膀胱像囊袋。

example: How could you buy a knife whose blade is chipped in several places?
example_zh: 你怎麼會買一把刀刃好幾處缺口的刀？
memory_hint: blade 指刀刃，也可指葉片或翼。

example: The soup was rather bland so I added some salt.
example_zh: 這碗湯很淡，所以我又放了一些鹽。
chinese: 溫和的；無刺激性的；淡而無味的
memory_hint: bland 表味道淡或性質溫和。

example: Lucy resisted Tom's blandishments.
example_zh: Lucy 拒絕了 Tom 的奉承。
memory_hint: blandish 的名詞形式，指奉承、甜言蜜語。

example: The trumpet blared, announcing the queen's arrival.
example_zh: 喇叭高鳴，宣布女王的到來。
chinese: 發嘟嘟聲；發出響而刺耳的聲音
memory_hint: blare 指響亮刺耳地鳴叫。

example: She was told a blatant lie.
example_zh: 她聽到一個露骨的謊言。
memory_hint: blatant 表公然、明目張膽的。

example: If you steep the stained cloth in bleach overnight first, you will save lots of time.
example_zh: 如果你先把髒衣服放在漂白劑裡浸泡一夜，你就會省去不少時間。
memory_hint: bleach 可作漂白劑，也可作漂白。

example: With the coming of the New Year, she received a blizzard of gifts.
example_zh: 隨著新年的到來，她收到大量禮物。
memory_hint: blizzard 除暴風雪外也可比喻大量湧來。

example: They threatened to impose a blockade on the country if the country didn't sign the agreement.
example_zh: 他們威脅該國若不在協議上簽字，就會進行封鎖。
memory_hint: blockade 指封鎖或障礙。

example: That modern building is a blot on the beauty of this ancient town.
example_zh: 這座現代建築有損這古鎮的美。
chinese: 污漬；瑕疵；有損整體美之物
memory_hint: blot 可指污點，也可比喻缺憾。

example: The boss told him if he blundered again, he would be fired.
example_zh: 老闆告訴他，如果他再犯大錯，就會被開除。
memory_hint: blunder 指犯嚴重錯誤。

example: You should use your head more; laziness has blunted your senses.
example_zh: 你應該多動腦筋；懶惰已使你變得遲鈍。
memory_hint: blunt 作動詞表使變鈍、遲鈍。

example: In the heavy fog, everything was a blur.
example_zh: 在濃霧之中，每個東西都很模糊。
memory_hint: blur 指模糊不清的影像或污跡。

example: He fell in love with the girl who had just bobbed at him.
example_zh: 他愛上了那個剛向他行屈膝禮的女孩。
chinese: 使上下或來回快速擺動；行屈膝禮
memory_hint: bob 可指快速上下擺動，也可指行屈膝禮。

example: They forgot their mother's warning and went into the bog to play.
example_zh: 他們忘記了母親的警告，跑到沼澤地去玩。
memory_hint: bog 指泥濘沼澤地。

example: She received some bogus bills.
example_zh: 她收到一些假鈔。
memory_hint: bogus 表假的、偽造的。

example: Her boyfriend's encouragement bolstered up her confidence.
example_zh: 她男朋友的鼓勵提高了她的自信心。
memory_hint: bolster up 表支持、增強。

example: Reporters bombarded the pop singer with questions about her emotional problem.
example_zh: 記者提出許多有關感情的問題圍攻這個流行歌手。
chinese: 不斷攻擊；連續提出問題
memory_hint: bombard A with B 表以大量事物連續轟擊 A。

example: The man who was in bondage to drug died last week.
example_zh: 那個被毒品奴役的男子於上週去世了。
memory_hint: bondage 指被束縛、奴役的狀態。

example: The guy who was in the booth on the corner looked a suspicious character.
example_zh: 那個在街角電話亭裡的人看上去很可疑。
chinese: 貨攤；公用電話亭；投票站
memory_hint: booth 指小亭、攤位或投票亭。

example: He owns a shop in Brooklyn, one of the five boroughs of New York City.
example_zh: 他在布魯克林區擁有一家商店，該區是紐約市的五個行政區之一。
memory_hint: borough 指城市中的行政區。

example: Have you ever been to the botanical garden in this city, which has plants from all over the world?
example_zh: 你有去過該城的植物園嗎？那裡有來自世界各地的樹木花草。
chinese: 植物學的；植物的；來自植物的
memory_hint: botanical garden 表植物園。

example: In learning botany, children understand much about nature.
example_zh: 透過學習植物學，孩子對大自然瞭解許多。
chinese: 植物學；一個地區的植物
memory_hint: botany 指植物學。

example: The newly reclaimed land is now bringing forth bountiful crops.
example_zh: 這片新開墾的土地正在豐收。
memory_hint: bountiful 表豐富、充裕。

example: Suffering from frequent bouts of depression, the man finally killed himself.
example_zh: 他因為罹患多發性憂鬱症，最後自殺了。
memory_hint: bout 可指一回合，也可指疾病的一次發作。

example: This cobbler is rather bovine.
example_zh: 這個補鞋匠真是笨手笨腳。
memory_hint: bovine 除牛的外，也可形容遲鈍笨拙。

example: If you eat too much spicy food, you will have lost bowels tomorrow morning.
example_zh: 如果你吃太多辛辣食物，你明天早上會拉肚子的。
memory_hint: bowel 指腸，也可指內部深處。

example: Tom Cruise and Brat Pitt were bracketed together for the Oscar Prize.
example_zh: 湯姆·克魯斯和布萊特·彼得同時被提名奧斯卡獎。
chinese: 用托架固定；相提並論；同時提名
memory_hint: bracket 可指把人或事物列在一起。

example: This evening dress trimmed with gold braid is very beautiful.
example_zh: 這條鑲著金色穗帶的晚禮服非常漂亮。
memory_hint: braid 指辮子或編織的飾帶。

example: It is said that the brassiere was invented by Otto Titzling.
example_zh: 據說奧托·提斯林發明了胸罩。
memory_hint: brassiere 即胸罩。

example: If you breach the contract, we will sue you.
example_zh: 如果你違反合約，我們就會控告你。
memory_hint: breach the contract 表違反合約。

example: A war seemed to be brewing in this country so people lived in fear.
example_zh: 這個國家似乎在醞釀一場戰爭，人們都生活在恐懼中。
memory_hint: brew 可指釀造，也可比喻事情正在醞釀。

example: As a soldier, you should act according to your briefing.
example_zh: 身為一個士兵，你應該按照作戰指示行事。
memory_hint: briefing 指簡報或任務指示。

example: He got very angry because he had received a brittle reception there.
example_zh: 他因在那裡受到冷淡的接待而非常生氣。
memory_hint: brittle 可指易碎，也可形容冷淡、敏感。

example: Remember this kind of fish should broil for 8 minutes.
example_zh: 記住這種魚應該烤 8 分鐘。
memory_hint: broil 指以高熱烤、炙。

example: The sculpture which was a bronze cast was a valuable asset.
example_zh: 這個用青銅鑄成的雕塑是個無價之寶。
memory_hint: bronze 指青銅或古銅色。

example: The clasp of her brooch was broken so she bought a new one.
example_zh: 她胸針的鉤子斷了，所以她買了一枚新的。
memory_hint: brooch 指裝飾用胸針。

example: I like the broth my mother cooks.
example_zh: 我喜歡我媽媽做的肉湯。
memory_hint: broth 指肉湯、清湯。

example: The bruise on his arm was a scald.
example_zh: 他手臂上的那塊傷痕是燙傷。
memory_hint: bruise 指碰撞造成的青腫、傷痕。

example: The first thing you should do after getting on the plane is to buckle yourself into your seat.
example_zh: 你上飛機後，第一件應做的事情就是扣緊安全帶。
memory_hint: buckle 可指扣緊，也可指彎曲。

example: Your encouragement has buffered his pain of failure.
example_zh: 你的鼓勵減輕了他失敗的痛苦。
memory_hint: buffer 作動詞表示緩衝、減輕。

example: She carried too much stuff in her handbag which caused a bulge.
example_zh: 她的手提包裝了太多東西，使她的包包鼓起來一塊。
memory_hint: bulge 指鼓起、凸出的一塊。

example: The bulk of the employees are against this proposal.
example_zh: 大多數員工反對這項提議。
chinese: 體積；大部分；巨大的東西
memory_hint: the bulk of 表大多數、大部分。

example: Her bulky figure makes it difficult for her to move!
example_zh: 她笨重的身軀使她難以移動！
chinese: 體積大的；龐大的；笨重的
memory_hint: bulky 表體積龐大、笨重。

example: I was bunkered but there was no one to help me.
example_zh: 我陷入了困境，但是沒有人幫助我。
chinese: 把球擊入沙坑；使陷入困境
memory_hint: bunker 作動詞可比喻使陷入困境。

example: We all agree that bureaucracy is absolutely bad and it should not exist in a perfect world.
example_zh: 我們都同意官僚政治是不好的，它不應該存在於一個理想的世界。
chinese: 官僚；官僚政治；形式主義
memory_hint: bureaucracy 指官僚制度或官僚作風。

example: I suppose your report has been lost by some incompetent bureaucrat.
example_zh: 我猜你的報告是被某個無能的官僚主義者弄丟了。
memory_hint: bureaucrat 指官僚或官僚作風的人。

example: If the government cannot get rid of bureaucratic practices, the management cannot screw up.
example_zh: 如果政府不去除官僚作風，管理部門就不能提高工作效率。
memory_hint: bureaucratic 為 bureaucracy/bureaucrat 的形容詞。

example: If you really have busted up, why don't you divorce each other?
example_zh: 如果你們真的已經決裂了，為什麼不離婚呢？
memory_hint: bust up 可表關係決裂。

example: The policemen have seized a cache of illegal drugs.
example_zh: 警察查獲一批非法藥物的藏匿處。
memory_hint: cache 指隱藏或貯藏東西的地方。

example: Calcium is the most plentiful mineral found in the human body, accounting for about 2% of an adult's total body weight.
example_zh: 鈣是人體中含量最多的礦物質，約佔成人總體重的 2%。
memory_hint: calcium 是人體重要礦物質。

example: This book, which is bound in calf, is one of my favorite books.
example_zh: 這本用小牛皮裝訂的書是我最喜愛的書之一。
memory_hint: calf 可指小牛、小牛皮或小腿。

example: He had a 32-caliber bullet in his hand.
example_zh: 他手中有一顆三十二口徑的子彈。
memory_hint: caliber 可指槍炮口徑，也可比喻能力。

example: Brush calligraphy, an art unique to Asian cultures, is highly regarded as an art form.
example_zh: 毛筆書法是亞洲文化獨有的藝術，被高度視為一種藝術形式。
memory_hint: calligraphy 指書法藝術。

example: No breath of calumny ever attained the personal purity of Savonarola.
example_zh: 沒有任何誹謗曾玷污薩佛納羅拉個人的清白。
memory_hint: calumny 指惡意誹謗、中傷。

example: It is reported a British peace campaigner has been kidnapped along with three other humanitarian workers in Iraq.
example_zh: 據報導，一名英國和平運動人士和另外三名人道工作者在伊拉克遭綁架。
chinese: 老兵；從事社會運動的人
memory_hint: campaigner 指投入運動或倡議活動的人。

example: He is a canary. He has betrayed his friends.
example_zh: 他是個告密者；他背叛了他的朋友。
memory_hint: canary 除金絲雀外，也可俚指告密者。
